planned_outcome: Land HMS Onslaught M21: extend M20 Stefan v2 with a distributed side-heat source term S(x,t) representing heat conducted in from tin sidewalls. 6-param fit (M20's 5 + new Q_side magnitude). Single-fixture decision gate on BA3C_0946 with bar main-bake RMSE less than 4 C and at least 4/6 params interior. Tests the 1D-vs-effective-2D assumption shared by all 18 prior inverse-problem missions.
actual_outcome: Side-heat hypothesis empirically refuted. M9 Stefan extended with distributed side-source S(x,t) = Q_side * w(x) * g_oven(t). Phase 1 sanity 2/2 PASS. Phase 2 synthetic recovery: 4/5 FAIL — optimizer always finds Q_side approx 1e4 regardless of true value (12K, 28K, 45K, 107K, 109K), proving Q_side is statistically unidentifiable from in-dough thermometry. Phase 3 single-fixture BA3C_0946: main-bake RMSE 5.66 C vs M9 5.76 C, improvement 0.1 C (within noise); 5/6 params interior; Q_side landed at 1.33e4 — the meaningless default. Decision gate FAILED. The 5-6 C floor is now confirmed structural across 20 inverse-problem missions, 5 model classes, 7 BC formulations, and 8 distinct free-parameter combinations including the brand-new side-heat term. Final verdict CONFIRM-information-limit; pivot to M18 Method 1 + Method 4 stub for production.
success_metric_result: Phase 2: 4/5 synthetic seeds FAILED to recover Q_side (61-90% relative error). Phase 3 BA3C_0946: 5.66 C vs M9 5.76 C — no improvement. Q_side is a degenerate parameter; in-dough sensors cannot separate side-heat from alpha/rhoL/smear effects.

adopt: Synthetic recovery is the gating test for inverse-problem viability — failure on synthetic with known truth proves identifiability is broken regardless of real-CSV result
avoid: Adding new free parameters that capture real physics but are statistically degenerate with existing parameters; 8 in-dough sensors have ~1 degree of freedom for cumulative-heat-into-dough effects
